JAXE!|[[Jaxe (Narrator)|Jaxe]] dialogue on Wave 1 ([[Rotfield]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Undead''' was the first enemy that appeared in [[Rotfield]] as part of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had average health and a slightly slow speed. ==Appearance== The '''Undead''' had a similar appearance to the [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]] from the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. It had green skin, and its torso and legs were brown slate. Its rib and right leg were cut open and exposed. It was faceless. ==Strategy== *A few Level 2 [[Military Base]]s can clear multiple '''Undeads''' out easily. *Since the '''Undead''' spawn in groups, multiple splash damage towers such as the [[Mortar]] are very useful against it. *A Level 2 [[Ace Pilot]] can be great against the '''Undead'''. *The [[Minigunner]] fares well against the '''Undead''', though you must wait a few waves before you can place it down. *Many beginner towers, such as the [[Scout]] or [[Soldier]], are good at eliminating the '''Undead.''' ==Update History== *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]a **'''Undead''' added. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Undead''' removed. {{Rotfield|Start|N/A|Undead|Wave 1|[[Mummy (Solar Eclipse)|Mummy]]|Wave 3}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Undead}}
